diagnosis.established: The error type and exact collector control flow locate the historical failure in server attestation before or after the owner-label census.
diagnosis.instrumentation: The exact pinned collector executes once. Transparent wrappers retain original return/raise decisions and record stage, before/after command, allowlisted operation and numeric error. Both cause and context are retained in a bounded sanitized graph; no retries or raw exception/CLI text.
diagnosis.not_established: The original receipt omitted exception text and numeric codes; its exact native operation and Win32 cause cannot be recovered from that receipt.
diagnosis.ordinary_native_fixture: A unique disposable local named pipe, created and opened only with the ordinary test token, returned ERROR_PIPE_BUSY (231) on a second handle attempt. No bytes were read or written. This reproduces one possible indistinguishable legacy error encoding, not the actual historical failure.

fixture_boundaries: Full-run tests use the real frozen support, installed configuration, actual six success receipts and actual public prior metadata. Protected custody, private knowledge bytes, RAM observations, task/controller identity and Docker transport are explicit inert fixtures. The Docker baseline is derived fixture data. Separate tests verify exact current public receipt and packet hashes.
operation_audit: All direct _check labels in the installed attest_docker_pipe_server, require_system, _account_sid, _sid_text, _token_info, and _acl routines are allowlisted; arbitrary messages remain unpublished.
